overal.goal: Fix stale and contradictory statements: docs/boof-runner.md still says budgets are tracking-only (:471, :487) although enforcement shipped; it says 32 MCP tools where the README and code say 34; the install script accepts Node >= 20 while package.json engines and the runbook say >= 22.22 (read the floor from package.json); the default clone URL is SSH (git@github.com) which fails on a fresh server without a key, default to https; README's desktop first-run paragraph mentions a header folder icon that no longer exists (it is the Browse… button and the project Settings page).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
